name: WHITEFOX
notes: Built 2026-11-11 from their own listing drones (23 Gold Coast listings, goldcoast.whitefoxrealestate.com.au; refs in raw/whitefox/pin-refs). Pin: their square glyph inside a thin white ring, see-through, about 7.5% of photo height, touching a thin white line that ends in a small dot on the house. Every photo also carries a big ring watermark, about 18% of height, at 60% opacity, centred 0.23 H in from the right and 0.16 H up from the bottom. Location labels are light sentence case with no dot and no distance (Poppins Light stands in for their sans). Land gets a dotted outline. The logo was redrawn from their photos (logos/whitefox-*.png), so ask for vector brand files before print. Location labels (their Arrowtown listing, 2026-11-12): sentence case, set to the LEFT of a long thin line's top end (about a third of frame height on their wides), no dot.
